name: Blue Heaven Blueberry Raspberry Farm
description: Blue Heaven Blueberry Raspberry Farm is a small berry farm in Middlefield, MA. It grows Blueberries, Raspberries, and Peas, with picking through summer and spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
